analysis.summary: AuSom Enterprise Limited published its Annual Report for the financial year ended March 31, 2023. The company carries out trading activities in commodities, bullions, gold jewellery, diamonds, derivatives, shares, and securities. For FY 2022-23, the company generated net sales/income from operations of Rs. 17,775.82 Lakhs and achieved a net profit after tax of Rs. 120.32 Lakhs.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates achieving a gross turnover of Rs. 1,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross turnover of Rs. 1,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts has been initiated.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the target of gross turnover will definitely be achieved and necessary resources have been generated.
guidance.quote: The management of the Company is of the view that the target of gross turnover will definitely be achieved and necessary resources for the same have also been generated.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not buy back any securities during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not bought back any of its securities during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company neither accepted nor renewed any deposits during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits during the year under review.
